value.rationale: The number and contact partition of rational hyperplanes in a canonical genus-four embedding are natural theta-type geometric invariants. The sharp four-plane bound and three extremal osculation strata are not just the known three-distinct-contact statistic; six extremal models display the exceptional triple sextuple-contact geometry. Reusable finite classification, not an arbitrary slice.
